established_facts: XPMEM clear errors other than ENOENT are logged, after which memobj ownership is dropped and the range is erased, uncached and freed; there is no rollback or quarantine handoff.
The remote TLB vector retains a caller address pointer until its pending counter reaches zero, but the caller supplies the untyped lifetime and no epoch or late-completion quarantine exists.
Page insertion and final hash removal share bucket locking but provide neither a descriptor pin nor a generation or destruction permit.
VM lifetime is a generic refcount/final-free sequence with no global recovery handoff.
missing_new_mechanisms: checked nonreused 64-bit OS, VM and descriptor generation allocation with explicit exhaustion failure
descriptor pin joined to hash membership and arena ownership
immutable clear/TLB permit with an owned address-buffer snapshot and late-completion identity
global quarantine owner receiving outstanding batches before VM or OS final release
lock order that releases page/hash and VM locks before shootdown and never waits while holding an IRQ-disabled pending lock
disposition: Current source cannot supply the authority contract. A source-bound design introducing these mechanisms requires independent ownership and unsafe review before implementation.
